exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: No weights are filled in. Start light, type what you lift on the first set, and the app remembers it from then on; when every set reaches 8 it will tell you to add weight. Feet flat, shoulder blades pinched, bar to the lower chest.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.notes: Hinge to about 45 degrees, pull the bar to the lower ribs, lower under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Elbows a little forward, press to lockout without leaning back.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Chest up, pull to the collarbones, control the way back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.notes: Superset with the pushdowns: one after the other, then rest.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.notes: Elbows pinned to the sides; only the forearms move.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Bar on the upper back, big breath, sit down between the knees, drive the floor away.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Soft knees, push the hips back until the hamstrings pull, bar close to the legs the whole way.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.notes: Feet shoulder width, lower until the thighs pass parallel, never lock the knees hard.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Superset with the calf raises. Squeeze at the top, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Pause at the bottom stretch and at the top.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Elbows under the shoulders, squeeze the glutes, one straight line.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Bar at the collarbones, squeeze the glutes, press straight up and move the head through at the top.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Use a band or the assisted machine if 6 is out of reach; hang a weight from a belt once 10 is easy.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Bench at about 30 degrees. Lower until the elbows are level with the shoulders.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.notes: Chest up, pull to the lower ribs, let the shoulder blades reach forward between reps.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Superset with the face pulls. Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Cable or band at face height. Pull to the ears with the elbows high.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.notes: Bar over mid-foot, hips high enough to keep the back flat, push the floor away. Reset every rep.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: 8 to 10 each leg, rear foot on a bench. Dumbbells in the hands once bodyweight is easy.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Upper back on a bench, chin tucked, drive the hips up and squeeze for a second at the top.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Pause at the top; do not swing the weight up.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.notes: Curl the pelvis up rather than just lifting the knees. No bar? Lying leg raises.
